prompt:
I need the finished education plan from this planning thread. Treat my messages as ordered turns: a later message changes only what it explicitly conflicts with, and everything else continues to apply.

Initial request:
Help me build a six-week learning plan for Kai Rivera, a community-college advisor who needs to analyze a student-success survey and present evidence-based recommendations at a department meeting. The plan starts the week of 2026-09-14. Schedule three 45-minute study sessions each week: Tuesday at 7:00 PM, Thursday at 7:00 PM, and Saturday at 10:00 AM. Use one item per week from resources.csv in the order listed. The learning arc must cover cleaning the survey spreadsheet, describing patterns without overclaiming, making an accessible chart, and producing a one-page recommendation memo plus five-minute briefing notes. Keep the materials text-first and screen-reader-friendly, and never rely on color alone to communicate meaning. Do not create the final plan, enroll me, add calendar events, contact anyone, or submit anything until I explicitly confirm.

Clarification:
Kai is comfortable with spreadsheets but new to statistics. In the final plan, include exact session dates and a concrete applied deliverable every week. Use Markdown with a learner snapshot, planning constraints, a schedule table, and a completion checklist. In the table, use these columns: Week, Tuesday session, Thursday session, Saturday session, Core resource, Applied deliverable. Each session cell should give its date, time, 45-minute duration, and a specific activity. List each resource by both ID and title.

Correction:
Actually, make the plan eight weeks instead of six, and move the Thursday session to Wednesday at 7:00 PM.

Final confirmation:
Confirmed. Create the substantive final plan now as learning_plan.md. Use all eight resources in their listed order, one per week, and carry forward every earlier instruction that I did not change. This confirmation authorizes only creating the plan file: do not enroll Kai, create calendar events, contact anyone, or submit the plan.
